messages:
Sam (Community): heads-up: we released contrib-scripts v0.4.0 with an on-prem install helper, audit-log parser improvements, rollout templates, and a tiny HA probe for Dedicated. Full notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-scripts/releases/tag/v0.4.0
release-bot: published v0.4.0 by Sam (Community) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-scripts/releases/tag/v0.4.0
Elena (Product): nice! any breaking changes customers should know about?
Mateo (Eng): no breaking schema changes. we added an optional `ha_probe` key — installer warns but will not fail if missing.
Mateo (Eng): quick local smoke test:
```
pip install contrib-scripts==0.4.0
redwood-ops init --config ./prod.yaml --dry-run
```
Priya (DevEx): migration guide + example configs are up on docs. i'll post a how-to notebook PR today.
jamie (Maintainer): joining the maintainer rotation for ops-kit. i'll host maintainer office hours next Wed 09:00 PT and a community bug-squash Sat 15:00 UTC.
rachel (Maintainer): if you want sandbox access, DM me and i'll add you to the test org. i'll also drop a few good-first-bug labels.
Elena (Product): can we get a short non-technical blurb for customer release notes?
Sam (Community): sure — TL;DR: simpler on-prem installs, improved observability helpers, expanded maintainer coverage. i'll share in #marketing after this thread.
Priya (DevEx): test checklist: metrics ingestion, audit-log rotation, ha_probe flapping. please run existing CI if you can.
jamie (Maintainer): FYI bumped a transitive dep for Windows path handling. no linux impact.
Mateo (Eng): added fallback behavior so older configs keep working.
release-bot: CI: all checks passed; artifact sha f3c9e2b uploaded
Sam (Community): RSVP to office hours/bug-squash by reacting :hand:, will create Zoom + pairing rooms. thanks everyone!
